scope: Presentation only; daily accounting, enforcement and browser behavior are unchanged.

design.runtime: Native SwiftUI shapes/text and existing macOS icons; generated concept is documentation only.
changes: Open canvas replaces the enclosing timer card.
Thin tick dial, tabular digits and explicit state text.
Daily limit shown once in the header.
Separate app/reset/coverage strip with accessible settings shortcut.
Vertical space adapts to taller windows.
Sidebar branding and temporary-access footer are quieter.
Long app selections cap visible icons and show a remaining count.

visualChecks: Ready state at 880 x 680 in light and dark.
Running state shows a decreasing balance and End access.
One-minute warning leaves End access and app strip visible.
Exhausted state shows 00:00, explains the reset and disables Start.
Minimum-size previews keep essential controls visible without scrolling.
Installed 980 x 780 window balances the dial and lower app strip.
limitations: No new CPU/memory benchmark; no performance target claim.
Browser tests were not rerun because browser source, protocol and permissions are unchanged.
